Question: 以下说法正确的是
A. 在const成员函数中不可以使用this指针；
B. 在static成员函数中不可以使用this 指针；
C. 抽象类的成员函数都是纯虚函数；
D. 抽象类的派生类必须实现抽象类中的纯虚函数。

Need choose correct statement. C++ concepts.
A: const member function can use this pointer? Yes, this is pointer to const object (const Class* const this). It can be used, just cannot modify. So A false.
B: static member function cannot use this pointer. True.
C: Abstract class has at least one pure virtual function; not all member functions are pure virtual. False.
D: A derived class of abstract class must implement pure virtual functions? If derived class is non-abstract, yes. But wording: 抽象类的派生类必须实现抽象类中的纯虚函数. Is it always? If derived class does not implement all pure virtual, it remains abstract and cannot instantiate. It can be a derived class that doesn't implement. So statement as universal false unless means to be concrete. In many exam contexts: "abstract class's derived class must implement pure virtual functions" might be considered correct? Need compare with B definitely correct. If single choice, B is most unequivocally true. D is often false because派生类 can also be abstract if not override all. Some textbooks say: 派生类若没有实现基类全部纯虚函数，则派生类仍为抽象类；若要创建对象必须实现. So D incomplete. B correct.
Need final line exactly 答案：B. Could include short explanation. Ensure last line. Chinese.
